   ## Adding links
   - Only edit `README.md` and only add new lines (max **10 links** per PR).
   - Format: `- [Name](https://example.com) — short description.`
   - Keep the name and description as plain text; do not add embedded links or HTML/Markdown.
   - Add each link to the right section, next to similar links.
   - Links must work, must not already be in the list, and must not use a URL shortener.
   - Adult/explicit content, gambling, graphic violence, illegal drug sales, and hate/extremist content are not allowed.
   - The automated check screens the submitted text and readable page text. Pages it cannot inspect need a maintainer's manual review and will not be auto-merged.

   Pull requests that pass all checks are merged automatically. Content screening is best-effort, so maintainers may still review any submission.
